Note that a &%Substance may nonetheless have physical properties that vary. For example, the temperature, chemical constitution, density, etc. may change from one part to another. An example would be a body of water.

nodes.label: Summary
nodes.definition: A short &%Text that is a summary of another, longer &%Text.

nodes.label: Sunday
nodes.definition: The &%Class of all calendar Sundays.

nodes.label: Surface Change
nodes.definition: &%Processes which involve altering the properties that apply to the surface of an &%Object.

nodes.label: Surgery
nodes.definition: Any &%TherapeuticProcess that involves making an incision in the &%Animal that is the &%patient of the &%TherapeuticProcess.

nodes.label: Symbolic String
nodes.definition: The &%Class of alphanumeric sequences.

nodes.label: Tactile Perception
nodes.definition: The &%subclass of &%Perception in which the sensing is done by &%Touching. Note that &%Touching need not involve &%TactilePerception. For example, a person who has lost all sensation in both of his legs would have no &%TactilePerception of anything his legs were &%Touching.

nodes.label: Taste Attribute
nodes.definition: The &%Class of &%Attributes relating to the taste of &%Objects.

nodes.label: Temperature Measure
nodes.definition: Measures of temperature. In scientific circles, the temperature of something is understood as the average velocity of the atoms or molecules that make up the thing.

nodes.label: Tesla
nodes.definition: SI magnetic flux density measure. Symbol: T. One &%Tesla equals one &%Weber per square &%Meter. &%Tesla = Wb/m^2 = kg*s^(-2)*A^(-1).

nodes.label: Text
nodes.definition: A &%LinguisticExpression or set of &%LinguisticExpressions that perform a specific function related to &%Communication, e.g. express a discourse about a particular topic, and that are inscribed in a &%CorpuscularObject by &%Humans.

nodes.label: Texture Attribute
nodes.definition: Any &%Attribute that characterizes the texture of an &%Object.

nodes.label: Thursday
nodes.definition: The &%Class of all calendar Thursdays.

nodes.label: Time Dependent Quantity
nodes.definition: A &%UnaryConstantFunctionQuantity of continuous time. All instances of this &%Class are returned by &%Functions that map a time quantity into another &%ConstantQuantity such as temperature. For example, 'the temperature at the top of the Empire State Building' is a &%TimeDependentQuantity, since its value depends on the time.

nodes.label: Time Duration
nodes.definition: Any measure of length of time, with or without respect to the universal timeline.

nodes.label: Time Interval
nodes.definition: An interval of time. Note that a &%TimeInterval has both an extent and a location on the universal timeline. Note too that a &%TimeInterval has no gaps, i.e. this class contains only convex time intervals.

nodes.label: Time Measure
nodes.definition: The class of temporal durations (instances of &%TimeDuration) and positions of &%TimePoints and &%TimeIntervals along the universal timeline (instances of &%TimePosition).

nodes.label: Time Position
nodes.definition: Any &%TimePoint or &%TimeInterval along the universal timeline from &%NegativeInfinity to &%PositiveInfinity.

nodes.label: Time Zone
nodes.definition: An &%Attribute which is used to specify coordinates in which time measures are uniform, i.e. all time devices are synchronized to the same &%TimePositions.

nodes.label: Tissue
nodes.definition: An aggregation of similarly specialized &%Cells and the associated intercellular substance. &%Tissues are relatively non-localized in comparison to &%BodyParts, &%Organs or &%Organ components. The main features of &%Tissues are self-connectivity (see &%SelfConnectedObject) and being a homogeneous mass (all parts in the same granularity are instances of &%Tissue as well).

nodes.label: Touching
nodes.definition: Any &%Transfer where two &%Objects are brought into immediate physical contact with one another.

nodes.label: Toxic Organism
nodes.definition: The &%Class of &%Organisms which are poisonous to other &%Organisms.

nodes.label: Trait Attribute
nodes.definition: &%Attributes that indicate the the behavior/personality traits of an &%Organism.

nodes.label: Transaction
nodes.definition: The &%subclass of &%ChangeOfPossession where something is exchanged for something else.

nodes.label: Transfer
nodes.definition: Any &%instance of &%Translocation where the &%agent and the &%patient are not the same thing.

nodes.label: Transportation
nodes.definition: &%Motion from one point to another by means of a &%TransportationDevice.

nodes.label: Transportation Device
nodes.definition: A &%TransportationDevice is a &%Device which serves as the &%instrument in a &%Transportation &%Process which carries the &%patient of the &%Process from one point to another.

nodes.label: Tree
nodes.definition: A Tree is a &%DirectedGraph that has no &%GraphLoops.

nodes.label: Truth Value
nodes.definition: The &%Class of truth values, e.g. &%True and &%False. These are &%Attributes of &%Sentences and &%Propositions.

nodes.label: Tuesday
nodes.definition: The &%Class of all calendar Tuesdays.

nodes.label: Unary Constant Function Quantity
nodes.definition: A &%subclass of &%FunctionQuantity, instances of which are returned by &%UnaryFunctions that map from one instance of the &%Class &%ConstantQuantity to another instance of the &%Class &%ConstantQuantity.

nodes.label: Unilateral Getting
nodes.definition: Any instance of &%Getting that is not part of a &%Transaction. In other words, any instance of &%Getting where nothing is given in return. Some examples of &%UnilateralGetting are: appropriating, commandeering, stealing, etc.

nodes.label: Unilateral Giving
nodes.definition: Any instance of &%Giving that is not part of a &%Transaction. In other words, any instance of &%Giving where nothing is received in return. Some examples of &%UnilateralGiving are: honorary awards, gifts, and financial grants.

nodes.label: United Kingdom Gallon
nodes.definition: Unit of volume commonly used in the United Kingdom.

nodes.label: United States Cent
nodes.definition: A currency measure. 1 &%UnitedStatesCent is equal to .01 &%UnitedStatesDollars.

nodes.label: United States Dollar
nodes.definition: A currency measure.

nodes.label: United States Gallon
nodes.definition: Unit of volume commonly used in the United States.

nodes.label: Unit Of Measure
nodes.definition: A standard of measurement for some dimension. For example, the &%Meter is a &%UnitOfMeasure for the dimension of length, as is the &%Inch. There is no intrinsic property of a &%UnitOfMeasure that makes it primitive or fundamental, rather, a system of units (e.g. &%SystemeInternationalUnit) defines a set of orthogonal dimensions and assigns units for each.

nodes.label: Vegetable
nodes.definition: &%Vegetable is a subclass of &%FruitOrVegetable.

nodes.label: Verb
nodes.definition: One of the parts of speech. The &%Class of &%Words that conventionally denote &%Processes.

nodes.label: Verb Phrase
nodes.definition: A &%Phrase that has the same function as a &%Verb.

nodes.label: Vertebrate
nodes.definition: An &%Animal which has a spinal column.

nodes.label: Violent Contest
nodes.definition: A &%Contest where one participant attempts to physically injure another participant.

nodes.label: Virus
nodes.definition: An &%Organism consisting of a core of a single nucleic acid enclosed in a protective coat of protein. A virus may replicate only inside a host living cell. A virus exhibits some but not all of the usual characteristics of living things.

nodes.label: Visual Attribute
nodes.definition: The &%Class of visually discernible properties.

nodes.label: Vitamin
nodes.definition: A &%Nutrient present in natural products or made synthetically, which is essential in the diet of &%Humans and other higher &%Animals. Included here are &%Vitamin precursors and provitamins.

nodes.label: Volt
nodes.definition: SI electric potential measure. Symbol: V. It is the difference of electric potential between two points of a conducting wire carrying a constant current of 1 &%Ampere, when the power dissipated between these points is equal to 1 &%Watt. &%Volt = W/A = m^2*kg*s^(-3)*A^(-1).

nodes.label: Volume Measure
nodes.definition: Measures of the amount of space in three dimensions.

nodes.label: War
nodes.definition: A military confrontation between two or more &%GeopoliticalAreas or &%Organizations whose members are &%GeopoliticalAreas. As the corresponding axiom specifies, a &%War is made up of &%Battles.

nodes.label: Warranty
nodes.definition: A &%Contract that states the cirumstances under which defects in the product will be corrected for no charge. A &%Warranty is usually limited to a length of time that is specified in the &%Warranty itself. A &%Warranty also includes information about what is not covered and actions that invalidate the &%Warranty.

nodes.label: Water
nodes.definition: The &%Class of samples of the compound H20. Note that this &%Class covers both pure and impure &%Water.

nodes.label: Water Area
nodes.definition: A body which is made up predominantly of water, e.g. rivers, lakes, oceans, etc.

nodes.label: Watt
nodes.definition: SI power measure. Symbol: W. A &%UnitOfMeasure that measures power, i.e. energy produced or expended divided by &%TimeDuration. It is the power which gives rise to the production of energy (or work) at the rate of one &%Joule per &%SecondDuration. &%Watt = J/s = m^2*kg*s^(-3).

nodes.label: Weapon
nodes.definition: The &%Class of &%Devices that are designed primarily to damage or destroy &%Humans/&%Animals, &%StationaryArtifacts or the places inhabited by &%Humans/&%Animals.

nodes.label: Weber
nodes.definition: SI magnetic flux measure. Symbol: Wb. It is the magnetic flux which, linking a circuit of one turn, produces in it an electromotive force of 1 &%Volt as it is reduced to zero at a uniform rate in 1 &%SecondDuration. &%Weber = V*s = m^2*kg*s^(-2)*A^(-1).

nodes.label: Wednesday
nodes.definition: The &%Class of all calendar Wednesdays.

nodes.label: Week
nodes.definition: The &%Class of all calendar weeks.

nodes.label: Word
nodes.definition: A term of a &%Language that represents a concept.

nodes.label: Year
nodes.definition: The &%Class of all calendar &%Years.
